lead: Jayaram Jayalalithaa was an Indian film actor, born on 24 February 1948 in Melukote.
She died on 5 December 2016 in Chennai at the age of 68.
She has 30 credited works on public record and has held the office of Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu and Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.

sections.heading: Jayaram Jayalalithaa — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jayaram Jayalalithaa was born on 24 February 1948 in Melukote, and holds citizenship of India and Dominion of India.
Public records name her father, Jayaram Rangachar and her mother, Veda Jayaram.
Her listed education includes Bishop Cotton Girls' School and Stella Maris College.
She is recorded as speaking Tamil and English.

sections.heading: Jayaram Jayalalithaa — Career and Professional Work
paras: Jayaram Jayalalithaa works primarily as a film actor, politician and dancer.

She has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2015–2016), Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2011–2014), Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2002–2006), Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2001–2001), Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (1991–1996) and Member of the 9th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly. She is affiliated with All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam.
